_note: Hand contact, step 11 of docs/asset-production/motions/npc-skeleton-mapping.md (2026-10-15 trial). A hand near a point of the real person's body is put at the same point of the stick figure. Every key is required. Head frame (person and figure alike): up = the mapped head direction (step 5), side = the two eyes' line made square to it (+ = the person's left), forward = side x up. Torso frame: step 5's (side = RightArm->LeftArm, up = Hips->Neck1). source.at: joints of the real person and their weights (summed); source.offset: [side, up, forward] in that part's frame, in units of the person's head radius (|HeadEnd - Head| / 2) for part head, of the person's torso (|Neck1 - Hips|) for part torso. figure, part head: dir [side, up, forward] in the figure's head frame and dist from the head centre in headR. figure, part torso: along (0 = hips, 1 = neck root), side and forward, in figure torso lengths; or arm: Left/Right and at: that arm's upper arm as steps 1-10 put it, at this share of the way from the neck root to the elbow. near / band: the hand (palm) at most near metres from the person's point puts the figure's hand fully on the figure's point; from near to near + band it eases back to steps 1-10. The hand's offset from the point is scaled by the two bodies' size ratio there (head: headR / head radius; torso: torso / torso length). palm: the hand point of the person, joints without their side. nearShare: with several points near, each one's share of the hand's place falls by e for every nearShare metres it is farther from the hand than the nearest one (the nearest leads; no jump when another becomes nearest). held: held types whose tip touches the body, and the tip's marker in the type (a node of its model): for a clip holding one of them in one hand (npc/clip-setup.json item), that hand counts as resting where the tip rests, and the tip goes to the figure's point at the thing's real size (the thing hangs from the hand upright, facing the way the clip faces, as the game hangs it); a listed type without the marker is an error. pair: the two hands as one more point of each other (scaled by the torso ratio). stillSpeed, speedSeconds, holdSeconds: a hand counts as on a point only while it rests there: near it, moving against it (the other hand for pair) slower than stillSpeed m/s (measured over speedSeconds), for at least holdSeconds without a break; passing by, hanging or swinging past counts for nothing. Worked out over the whole clip at export, never at play. smoothSeconds: every weight is spread over this much time before and after (largest, then a Hann average), so a hand eases in and out instead of jumping. elbowFront: the elbow may point backwards only for a hand behind the neck by more than this (figure units; between -elbowFront and +elbowFront it eases). headClear: the forearm and hand keep this far outside the head disc (figure units, beyond headR); upperArmClear: the same for the upper arm (its neck-root end is itself only 0.015 below the disc, so it can keep no more than about that). elbowSamples: positions tried round the elbow circle when an arm cuts the head. pushMax: furthest a hand is moved off the head axis when no elbow position keeps the arm out of the head (figure units); if even that does not free it, the hand stays and the elbow takes its clearest position.
